bias: He's back. Another sluggish breakout last week and sellers did nothing with it. Friday closed AT resistance on everything — NQ into 31125-45, ES just under 7869-72, YM at 51969-52056, even RSP. The bull case is all of those clear and flip to support; failing them to start the week isn't automatically bearish because bulls have room to buy a dip. 'The burden of proof is very much on sellers to find follow through for once' — they need to step in early AND follow through or they get run over again. Monday is a bank holiday (cash bonds closed) and Friday's volume was abysmal, so he'd wait for Tuesday before reading too much into anything.

brief.happened: Thursday's selling held the weekly pivot 7780-84 (week RTH low 7778.25, ETH 7760.25), so 'trading lower' never triggered — instead a fresh 5-day balance overlapping the prior multi-week one, and Friday closed above the old multi-week range top 7846-49. Friday: YM names ripped, ES framed higher all day until the last 30 min, high 7870.5, closed 7861 right under 7869-72. Value gapped higher on the week; sellers triggered a LAAF week off the 7897.5 ATH but couldn't capitalize.
brief.higher: Sustain above 69-72 → 7886-88, then 7893-96 and last week's 7897.5 high; 7880 is an honorable mention for continuation. A true gap up that holds 69-72 from above is the safest long. Above the week's high he's monitoring levels for continuation — not blindly shorting in price discovery — but aware that multiple nominal ATHs have led to selling (7917-20 is the prior extension that could do it again).

brief.lower: 69-72 stays resistance (incl. after a LAAF) → 53 and 46-49 in play. Trading lower first (Sunday night?) and holding/LBAF-ing 53 is constructive for a trip back to 69-72; same for 46-49 with a 53/54 reclaim. If 46-49 fails there's demand at 38-40 for a first-pass reaction, which would need 46-49 and 53-54 reclaimed. Trapped below 46-49 after that demand → Friday's low 7826.75. Any failure to get to and through Friday's low likely gets bought. A LBAF of Friday's low needs ~7832 reclaimed to have a shot at 46-49. Persistent weakness below 7815-20 with time and volume → 7780-84 again.
brief.pivot: 7869-7872 is the line. 7853 (daily, used in Discord Friday) and 7846-49 under it; 7886-88 daily, 7893-96 and the 7897.5 ATH above.

brief.happened: Quite different from ES: a 6-day balance overlapping the prior multi-day and multi-month balances. Friday's low held just off the June high (951-969) and it closed just above the September high — but INTO 31125-45 resistance, never above its open after the first moments, OR5 mid capped the afternoon. Friday premarket high 31266.5 failed just under 269-288 and is a potential 30-min lower high. Week: high 31616.5 Tuesday, low 30792 Thursday; bearish Tue→Wed RTH gap 31422-31458.
brief.higher: Sustain above 125-145 → Friday's high 31180 (wary of a LAAF) → 269-288 weekly. A rejection at 269-288 comes back to test Friday's high with 125-145 a 'must hold' for a second break. A LAAF of Friday's high that flips 125-145 back to resistance makes a bearish engulfing of Friday's RTH range quite likely. Weekly: 125-145 ↔ 269-288 is rotational; 400-420 LAAF watch in the 31422-458 gap; firm reclaim of 469-481 → week high 31616.5.
brief.lower: 125-145 stays resistance (incl. after a LAAF) → 056-069, which is more likely reactive (incl. LBAF) if we trade lower first. Either way 125-145 must be reclaimed to prevent a move to Friday's low 30991 and 951-969. A LBAF of Friday's low needs 056-069 reclaimed to run at 125-145. Below last week's low 30792 → 706-725, then the 546-706 demand distribution (first-pass effect; 625 VPOC, 595-635 and 669-681 daily) → 504-546 → 30216.5 big picture.
brief.pivot: 31125-31145 is 'absolutely critical to start the week' and sets the tone early. 31056-69 (Sept RTH high) below it, Friday's low 30991 and 951-969 under that.
